name: Decieve Woman For Sex
overview: Scripture reveals the deep deceitfulness of the human heart, which is described as desperately wicked and full of fraud and mischief, including the use of lies to harm others. Those who deceive, particularly for selfish and sinful purposes such as sexual immorality, are warned that their actions are condemned and will lead to judgment. The Bible makes clear that all liars and those who engage in corrupt behavior will face the second death, emphasizing the seriousness of deceit in any form. This calls believers to uphold truth and purity, recognizing the danger of deceitful intentions and the eternal consequences they bring.
